caption: The open Gulf of Alaska west of Haida Gwaii (islands at right) seen by NASA's Aqua satellite on 13 May 2012, two months before the iron release.

Boats at Fisherman's Wharf in Victoria, British Columbia, on 2 August 2012; the Ocean Pearl sailed from Victoria that summer (it is not in this photo).
